after-listening-to-what-inside-my-mind-t:
Tang Yu transmigrates into a modern urban novel as a wealthy second-generation villain. Each time he survives a segment of the plot, he earns a reward!
He decides to lay low and survive until the very end! He starts by calling off an engagement to avoid getting killed by the Dragon King!
However, everyone around him seems to be plotting against him, insisting on pulling him into conflict.
Su Muyue: “You want to break off the engagement? No, you don't.”
Father-in-law: “Who does Ye Chen think he is? My son-in-law can only be Tang Yu.”
Bodyguard Captain: “Young Master Tang has been incredibly kind to me, I will kill the Dragon King for him.”
No matter how much Tang Yu tries to stay out of the plot, someone always shows up to drag him back into the fray.
To ensure his safety, Tang Yu has no choice but to defeat the Dragon King.
as-a-cardinal-i-dont-do-overtime:
Morn transmigrates into a fantasy world where demons run rampant, vampire families stand tall in the darkness all year round, werewolves that are preparing for something in the darkness, and angels who occasionally descend into the human world.
As a cardinal of the Orthodox Church, Morn had been bound to the nine-to-five system after he arrives in this world. As long as he’s at work, he can obtain a large number of rewards by checking in.
Therefore, having been in the ten years of the Orthodox Church, he becomes an invincible existence. Although he is the strongest in the Orthodox Church, he has one flaw—he never works overtime.
Your Holiness, Cardinal Morn personally went to the Dark Forest and killed all the dark cat demons.
Your Holiness, Cardinal Morn just returned from the Bloodthirsty Demon Abyss with the head of the Bloodthirsty Demonic Dragon
Your Holiness, this is bad! Dracula I brought his army of vampires here to take revenge.
Pope: “Quick, get Cardinal Morn.
B-but Cardinal Morn has knocked off. He has a rule that he works 9-to-5. He never works overtime
Pope: We’re doomed. Our Orthodox Church’s 300-year history shall end here.…
awakening-the-useless-class-but-my-talen:
Most dream of awakening elite Mage or Warrior branches, hoping for even a single A-rank spark.
So when Mike awakened as a Common Knight, the lowest of all combat classes, no one was surprised.
But when his Potential appeared as F-rank, the absolute bottom… everyone immediately dismissed him.
A Knight with F potential is a death sentence.
A future of mediocrity.
A life destined to be stepped on.
And yet—
The awakening didn’t end.
Beneath the worthless class and shattered potential, something impossible flickered to life:
Talent: ??? — Rank SSS.
A mythical talent that shouldn’t exist.
An F-rank Knight with an SSS-rank Talent.
black-bellied-belle-demon-lord-bite-the-:
The first time they met they had battled fiercely, just for a mere bunch of herbs. She needed it to save people, and he wanted to use it to save his own life.
“Let go of it, or you will die.” The man’s violet eyes were cold and sinister as he said in a low voice.
She held on tightly to the base of the herb and pulled its roots right out of the ground, before she turned her eyes back with a crafty smile. “It’s mine now. Snatch it from me if you can.”
When they met several years later they were no longer on opposing sides in hostility. In order to repay the debt for having stolen the herb back then, she went on to miraculously cure his body’s condition, relieving him of the inhumane torment that wrecked at his body day and night. He was amazed by the godly skills in Medicine she possessed and his heart went on to fall irrecoverably head over heels in love.
class-awakening-working-hard-can-evolve-:
Five hundred years ago, dungeons erupted across the world.
The people who first entered the dungeons discovered two important things that would shape the future of Earth.
One, terrifying deadly monsters inhabit these dungeons, and when left alone for a period of time, they would be released to Earth.
Two, humans who entered these dungeons awakened a Class and gained corresponding skills related to that class, giving them power to defend themselves.
Combining these two, the Age of Classes began on Earth.
…
Zeke Starlight was the heir of the upper-class family, Starlights. He lived in the renowned, advanced Magic Capital and was engaged to a beautiful, talented girl.
He was favored by the heavens, a chosen one.
But all of that was lost when he awakened the weakest class, [Stick Master], in the awakening ceremony.
Overnight, his life collapsed.
His fiancée's family severed their engagement to him and he was scorned by everyone he knew.
He was even disowned by his family, exiling him to a dangerous and resource scarce region, known as the Red Land, a death zone for humans.
If nothing went wrong, Zeke was destined to die pathetically, abandoned and full of resentment.…
dawn-walker:
Null, a realm above universes where chaos energy decides who lives and who becomes a warning. All gods lives here.
Sekhmet Dawn captured and offered as a sacrifice, he is forced to swallow a frozen shard of blood tied to a forgotten Walker, a blood god whose will tries to hijack his body.
At the edge of death, Sekhmet mother's pendant dissolves and awakens as a hidden Abyss class artifact, forming a Blood System that shields his soul and seals the invading will.
In a violent possession, the half god Benimaru and his tribe are wiped out. Sekhmet returns to himself, horrified, now bound to powers he never asked for and a mystery lineage he cannot ignore.
(Another Name: Blood Lord)
debauchery-of-a-soul-eating-wraith:
“From here on out, I'll only do what I want. What makes me Happy”
After years at a dead-end job, Evian finally has enough and quits to pursue his passions but before he could even revel in his new freedom, tragedy struck and he became a creature of Decadence.
Condemned to a life of devouring souls in exchange for strength, Evian is pulled out of the world he knew and made to possess the body of a namesake in a different world of Magic and all sorts of wonder.
A world home to different races taking residency in their own separate corners of it.
In this new world, Evian will find so many opportunities opened to him and it won't take long for him to begin to indulge in those opportunities.
After all, Souls taste good but beauties- Beauties taste even better...
descent-of-the-demon-god:
The leader of the thousand demons, the Demon God Chun YeoWoon. Due to an unfortunate accident, he had been sent to the distant future.
The Gate has opened, the future is now in chaos. The fight to return back into the past begins.
dreaming-worlds-rpg-im-the-weakest-one-i:
Title: Dreaming Worlds RPG
Nagato Nawfi, a seventeen-year-old high school student, has always harbored feelings for his childhood friend, Ayane. However, fear held him back from confessing. One day, he finally gathers the courage to propose to her after school. But when he reaches her classroom, he witnesses another boy confessing to Ayane—and to his heartbreak, she accepts. Devastated, Nagato decides to keep his feelings to himself and walks away in silence.
On his way home, he sees a girl in danger—a speeding truck is about to hit her. Without hesitation, he rushes to save her, pushing her out of harm’s way. However, in doing so, he ends up in front of the truck himself. The last thing he sees is the blinding headlights before everything fades to black.
When Nagato regains consciousness, he finds himself in an entirely different world—a fantasy realm that operates like an RPG. The problem? He has never played an RPG game in his life. Lost and confused, he embarks on a journey to uncover the truth behind his sudden reincarnation and the purpose of his existence in this world.
Meanwhile, back on Earth, his friends struggle to make sense of his mysterious disappearance.…
dungeon-life: A normal guy gets hit by a truck and isekai'd. Why? Because trucks are apparently some cosmic loophole. He decides to be a dungeon, because it sounds weird and interesting to be one. Is it? Let's find out.
for-better-for-worse-the-serpents-contra:
[18+ | Mature Content | Dark Romance]
Anastasia Morri has lived a fairytale life as a mafia princess, sheltered from the world of blood and violence. But everything changed when her sister was brutally murdered.
Two years later, her own father sells Anastasia to the same man responsible for her sister’s death.
“Zade Salvero” The most feared and ruthless Don of Hightower City, infamously known as the Serpent, with a smile that can make your skin crawl, and words as deadly as the poison that runs through his veins.
On paper, Anastasia is his beloved bride. Yet in truth, she's nothing but his “property”.
This is a fate she can’t escape because daughters only obediently nod their heads and do as they are told, but not Anastasia… She is a caged spitfire that won’t bend easily.
“You may have bought me, Don Salvero, but you have no idea what you've brought into your home.”
“Then I suppose I'll enjoy finding out, Mrs. Salvero.”
Anastasia knew one thing then... the only way she'd come out of this was in a body bag. Not without dragging him down with her first.
For better, for worse? Oh, please... this is dead or alive.
**********

from-apocalypse-boss-to-farmer-my-vegeta:
In the autumn of the 28th year of the apocalypse, Gu Xi and her companions finally eliminated the last Zombie Emperor in the world.
That night, at the celebration banquet held at the base, Gu Xi took the fine wine handed to her by a companion, and then... she collapsed headfirst.
When she woke up again, it was already the 58th year of the apocalypse.
30 years had passed, and the beautiful world that Gu Xi had once yearned for and for which she had fought tooth and nail did not appear.
Although human society had restored order, a new food crisis arose—after plants and animals underwent a second mutation, a bizarre energy that the human body could not digest, absorb, or excrete through metabolism suddenly appeared within them.
And she, Gu Xiaoxi, also had a brand-new identity—a refugee girl picked up from the ruins by a group of pioneers.
The newly-minted undocumented girl, Gu Xiaoxi: No more fighting and killing, no more shouldering the future of all humanity; just needing to cultivate one hundred acres of wasteland to achieve the simple dream of eating well, drinking well, and getting a peaceful night's sleep is pretty good.…
game-of-thrones-holy-flame-king:
[Quan You Fan: You can read without barriers even if you haven’t read the original book or TV series]
after many years,
When the legendary lord, the dragon knight, the son of the holy flame, the nightmare of the schemer, the smasher of the order of the game, the undefeated myth on the battlefield, the ruler of the seven kingdoms and the guardian of the whole territory——
When Samwell Caesar sat on the Iron Throne,
He must have thought of that distant afternoon when he got the pioneering order from the Rose of Highgarden.
At that time, no one could have imagined that this young man abandoned by his father would set off an iron-blooded storm that would sweep across the entire continent of Westeros.
global-dungeon-my-support-is-too-strong:
On a certain day, dungeons from another dimension suddenly appeared on Earth and monsters started to invade human civilization.
Humans were forced to form hunting parties to conquer dungeons.
Hunters can be separated into different jobs, including Knights, Warriors, Archers, Magicians, Assassins, and Supporters.
Each job had its own responsibility when they fought together.
When Lu Benwei was transmigrated to this world, he got the weakest job and became a Supporter.
Fortunately, he received the One-click Support System.
Resource Support: Click to receive 10x experience, 10x item drop, 10x money drop.
Walk Through Wall Support: Click to increase speed and unlock the ability to walk through walls. There’s no place that you can’t go in the dungeons.
X-Ray Vision Support: Click to clear the fog and locate every hidden chest and mission.
Health Lock Support: Click to lock your health. You’ll be immune to any damage for a set amount of time.
Storage Support: Click to expand your storage. You can store as many items, pets, and runes as you want.…
heir-of-manabeast-made-king:
In a world where race and power decide everything, one bloodline suffers more than all others.
The Beast-born, descendants of the god-beasts, blessed by the world itself were hunted, enslaved, and broken.
Their divine gift became their curse.
But one rises.
A beast who refuses to kneel.
Thrown into a brutal succession war where the victor becomes ruler of that is holy and unholy, Azreal must fight against angels , demons, and mortals alike.
To win means freedom, love, and dominion.
To lose means to kneel or die
This is the story of chains shattered, thrones conquered, and a beast who will rule heaven, hell, and everything between.
Disclaimer:The cover art is not mine. All credit goes to the original artist. If requested, I will take it down immediately.
i-dont-want-to-be-loved:
Rihannan Alessin, a queen rotting in prison.
Despaired and without hope, she drank poison and died. But… unbeknownst to her, the deity gave her a second chance at life. She was twelve again. And this time, she would live life differently.
Six years later, she chooses to become Arundell’s queen…
“If you’re asking me to step down from the marriage proposal, I can’t.”
“Marry me and let us divorce after a year.”
And this time, the time limit of their marriage would last a year.
A husband she knew who was different than before… she tried not to love him again, but each time, her heart kept shaking.
i-got-isekaid-well-shyt:
A 27-year-old American named Ryan was doing his usual morning run through a forest in the United States Midwest when he was attacked by a magical orb that transported him to another world. While in this other World, he finds himself captured by a tribe of Dark Elves that summoned him and another human. This other guy that was captured with Ryan, is a Japanese teen who goes by the name Hiro.
Unfortunately for Ryan, Hiro is a delusional edgy otaku who believes he's the Main Character and thinks he can get away with anything.
This just adds more of an obstacle for Ryan to overcome. And he's worried about what the Dark Elves are planning to do with them as they force them to kill monsters. Causing their bodies to absorb mana.
At some point the Dark Elves get attacked by a holy group known as the Divine Three, who are trying to rid the world of all subspecies, try to murder him. Ryan barely escaped with his life only for him to get chased by goblins into a Labyrinth. And worst of all, the mana from all the humans and monsters he had slayed has been affecting his body in weird ways as he begins to transform into a Dark (Female?!?) Elf with the extremely rare ability to heal anything.…
i-grind-to-martial-saint:
The ancient, decadent world is collapsing, and a stirring malevolence is descending from the void.
Han Yuan accidentally transmigrated, only to see a terrifying and dark world.
Noble Families, Sects... many powers are entrenched in their own territories, ambitious, and wish to overturn heaven and earth.
What Han Yuan can rely on is only the Martial Arts proficiency panel that he has awakened.
As long as he keeps grinding, he can raise his Martial Arts realm, and Cultivation to Perfection can even transform them into Martial Arts Divine Powers.
Breaking the Sky, Tiger Evil, Seven Kills Sword Soul, Copper Skin and Iron Bones, Desolate Thunder Heart Furnace, Heavenly Dipper and Earthly Fiend.......
i-just-wanted-to-watch-tv-but-now-im-in-:
What happens when a Good Faithful Servant of Christ dies from being overworked?
Thane did not expect that he, a Five Talent Christian, would be offered a reincarnation package, something that the Bible doesn't even mention once, and also carry a special perk of his choice!
Thane’s choice? What else would a Bible-Believing, Grace Driven Christian chose but to have the ability to watch TV, any time, anywhere, and would still be not disrupted of his time with work, ministry, and possibly love.
Yes.…
i-married-a-commander-and-became-a-galax:
Rumor has it that the Supreme Commander of the Interstellar Federation, Qin Shiwei, is cold, disciplined, and completely uninterested in women—yet he unexpectedly registered his marriage to a single mother from the Lower Star District, supposedly to repay a debt of gratitude.
The entire Federation was stunned.
To everyone else, Shu Yao was nothing more than a woman from the Lower Star District—dragging along a child, unworthy of the First Commander’s status. People mocked her relentlessly, telling her to take her son and return to where she came from, even if it meant scavenging through trash.
But what they didn't know was that this “lowly” single mother was, in fact, the long-lost daughter of the Shu Family, missing for thirteen years.
And that was only the beginning.
Shu Yao was not just a missing heiress. She possessed a portable dimension, could inscribe talismans to modify mechas, and was secretly the legendary Pharmacy Master whispered about in the Lower Star District.
On top of that, she was also the faceless top-tier gourmet streamer on the Star Network—“Mrs. Bao”—who rose to superstardom overnight after her debut.…
im-a-spinosaurus-with-a-system-to-raise-: After dying following a car accident, Fen Chiang finds himself in a limbo between the afterlife and the mortal world where he meets God, who makes him a strange request: to immediately reincarnate in a world called Eden, where all species that existed on Earth (dinosaurs, prehistoric mammals, synapsids, pterosaurs, etc.) coexist together, to save it from the human beings who are destroying it due to excessive pollution. Armed with his knowledge and a System, our hero, now reincarnated as a spinosaurus named Sobek, must embark on a difficult journey to reunite the dinosaurs and curb humanity's greed. However, defeating the most powerful species that ever existed will not be an easy task even for a dinosaur army, and surely humanity will not abandon the title of dominant species very easily...
immortal-refiner:
Birth, aging, sickness, and death are all part of being human. Li Qing, who was never afraid of dying, suddenly gains the ability to see exactly how much lifespan he has left — and that freaks him out!
Fortunately, refining artifacts grants him additional lifespan. So, he decides: “Let’s live for tens of thousands of years first, then worry about everything else!”
[Successfully refined a Mortal-Grade Weapon: Refined Iron War Halberd — Lifespan +5 months!]
[Successfully refined a Supreme-Grade Magical Artifact: Heavenly Net Banner — Lifespan +70 years!]
[Successfully refined a Transcendent Spirit Treasure: Annihilation Furnace — Lifespan +3000 years!]
(Immortality Survival + Artifact Refining + Dual Worlds)

kill-the-sun:
Earth, thousands of years after the apocalypse.
Countless technologies and advances had been lost to time as the Specters, horrifying beings with terrifying powers, arrived and destroyed the world.
Over the coming thousands of years, humanity had built itself up but always died again.
Nobody remembers the past.
Nobody remembers what humanity had once accomplished.
Now, everyone is living in a world where the Specters reign supreme.
-----
A boy with amnesia woke up in the middle of the Dregs, the worst part of Crimson Fungus City.
The boy grows up and manages to become strong enough to pass an exam for one of the most prestigious jobs in existence, a Zephyx Extractor, someone that can harvest the powers of Specters.
Sadly, he had already gained a power from a Specter in the past, which made him ineligible for the position.
But then, a mysterious man visits him.
And his luck finally turns around.
magus-codex:
[Initializing…]
[Magus Codex Activation Sequence fully loaded. Commencing integration…]
Derek Lewis was born Inept.
Unlike the heirs of the other powerful households in the Theocracy, he would never become a Magus.
After enduring total ostracism for years and almost dying from an assassination one fateful night, he is saved by a stranger who bestows the mysterious Magus Codex (M.A.X) to him.
M.A.X is a sophisticated Artificial Intelligence that exceeds the understanding of the current world. With its power, Derek Lewis has the potential to surpass even the greatest Magus in history and achieve unattainable heights!
Just how far can Derek go in a world rigged against him?

Let me know what you think in the comments and reviews.
maou-sama-no-machizukuri-saikyou-no-danj:
Beings that create and control monsters and demons, beings that build and reign over malicious labyrinths, the chosen individuals to possess an overwhelming Unique Skill… They are the Demon Lords.
Demon Lords entice people to come to the labyrinth they’ve built and eat the people’s despair as their nourishment.
However, Creation Demon Lord Procell has decided that he will obtain people’s hopes and not their despair as nourishment, and built a happy town instead of a malicious labyrinth to collect human beings.
This is the story of an eccentric Demon Lord, his inner thoughts, and his poker face.
me-the-strongest-alchemist:
This is a world of swords and magic. Here, sorcerers and knights are well established, while alchemists and forge smiths are revered by the Empire. Mas transmigrated from Earth to this world and became an apprentice alchemist. This was a very noble status, a brilliant alchemist could command the respect of any major city. Mas was also proud of his own position. But he didn’t expect that his teacher was actually a huge fraudster, who used subpar alchemy products to trick the Royal Capital.
When they came knocking on the door fuming with killing intent, Mas’s teacher Wosk had already run away. While Mas, who was his student, was left behind to deal with this mess. If Mas was unable to hand up alchemy products that are powerful enough, he would be burnt alive by the people of the Great Empire. Just then, he finally awakened the God-tier Alchemist System and received the Creator’s Alchemy Station. On this station, any monster could be created. [Obsidian Gargoyle], [Lightning Naga], [Iron Golem], [Granite Golem], [Puppet Dragon], [Laval Titan]...... One after another legendary alchemy creatures were born in the hands of Mas, and he gradually gained the title of the God of Alchemy!
monster-musume-harem-wo-tsukurou:
On his usual way to home Mikado Tsuchio fell into a hole that suddenly opened on the ground. Just like that, Tsuchio falls in a different world, he lands on a Grappler Wyvern and manages to tame it.
Tsuchio decides just like that to live in the other world, the reason for his quick decision: he wants to make a monster girl harem.
my-black-bellied-boyfriend:
My brother* and I, from elementary school to university, had grown up together. We didn’t just get into the same degree, we’re also sharing the same dormitory room.
Others may think that our brotherly bond is close but in fact, without my knowledge, he actually had ulterior motives.
Finally, one day, his wolfish intentions were revealed.
I had thought that with my rejection, he would give up but…. This actually became the reason for him to openly tease me?
Ah, everywhere were traps.
Question: What to do if the person chasing me is too black-bellied?
Answer: The best solution —— Accept him.
my-blood-legacy-bloodlines:
Victor was born marked by a silent curse.
Descended from an ancient lineage whose power never awakened, he carried in his veins the extremely rare RH-Null—the so-called “golden blood” among vampires. But instead of glory, supernatural gifts, or prestige, what he inherited was a cruel and inexplicable disease that slowly consumed him over thirty years.
While others of his kind rose to power, Victor withered away.
Only one person remained by his side: his mother. A woman once feared and revered, who abandoned fame, authority, and even her own vitality to keep him alive for one more day, one more night. All the sacrifices were in vain. The disease won.
In his last breath, however, when darkness finally enveloped him, a soft voice—almost amused—whispered in his mind. It called him a “little experiment.” It made a single request:
“Become the strongest.”
And then, the impossible happened.
Victor awoke again at sixteen.
His body was healthy. His bloodline, at last, awakened. The blood that once killed him now pulsed with a power dormant for generations. No trace of the disease remained—only memories, regrets, and the promise of that voice.…
my-ex-girlfriend-is-the-strongest-guild-:
** A Light Novel featuring a weak protagonist tasked with the impossible mission of saving a Virtual Reality world that has moved on without him. This post-apocalyptic sci-fi is brimming with drama, conspiracies, and action. **
As the Santa María spaceship travels the galaxy in search of a new home for humanity, all passengers must remain in cryosleep and log into The Novus, a Virtual Reality MMORPG designed to train the younger generation in building a civilized society.
Not only is this place a utopia, but it’s also a fresh start for seventeen-year-olds Alan and Astrid, who have just started dating.“Life in The Novus will be awesome with you by my side!”
But an emergency pulls Alan out of the system—a catastrophe that endangers the lives of the Santa María's population and their mission.
What will he find when he returns?
Three years have passed. Astrid has become one of the strongest warriors, and Alan... is now the weakest User in the virtual world.
my-fortune-blessed-leading-lady:
Fu Yuran, a genius actor crowned as a queen upon her debut, basked in endless glory; Yuran, a prodigal, frivolous, and brainless rich third-generation heir.
Fu Yuran never thought that upon her sudden death, she would become Yuran, sharing the same name but vastly different in standing, not to mention living at the mercy of others and having an infinitely dazzling movie emperor ... brother?
Yuran, who had intended to keep a low profile and strive to better herself, was one day scandalized as the “little demon” cohabitating with the great movie emperor, Yen Shen. Such gossip, truly malicious and insane!
Lately, Yuran replied with no expression, “No, I'm not close with Yen Shen, you've misunderstood. How could Yen Shen possibly take a fancy to me?”
Just when the dust seemed to be settling, some media personnel surprisingly caught her hand in hand with Yen Shen, and she still spoke earnestly and nonsensically, “We're just acting, don't misunderstand!”
Yen Shen, “Let me formally introduce, my wife, Yuran!”
my-princess-holds-superpowers:
The famed War King set his sights on a simple farmer's daughter, not hesitating to keep himself pure as he engaged in nurturing her.
Everyone thought that Sikong Mo, the War King, was destined to be a bachelor for life, but unexpectedly, news came that the renowned War King was to be wed, and his bride was to be a mere farmer's daughter.
The daughters of the rich and noble roared in outrage, “Why her?”
Sikong Mo appeared silently, “Because I said so.”
Born of wealthy parents, she was abandoned by them once again, replaced and poisoned, but fate did not forsake her, allowing her to cling stubbornly to life.
Sikong Mo, “I empathize with you, we are a match made in heaven.”
Ye Jiu, “No, no, no, we are not the same. I have the Golden Finger, helping me reach the pinnacle of life.”
Sikong Mo, “Hmm? Have you forgotten who gave you that Golden Finger?”
Ye Jiu deflated a bit guiltily, and slipped away.
With Plane Space at hand, wealth throughout the world is unparalleled.
my-sister-the-heroine-and-i-the-villaine:
Upon meeting the girl who would become her adopted younger sister, the duke’s daughter Christina regained memories of her previous life. Through those memories, she learned that her new sister, Mishuli, was the heroine of a certain story. And though the story depicted a Christina who abused her sister, the real Christina turned into a siscon who spoiled Mishuli to no end.
Unfortunately, one day, Christina realized something. The best future for Mishuli depended on that story’s ending. And by following that story, whether it was execution, suicide, or exile, nothing fortunate would await Christina.
Even knowing this, Christina would not waver.
It was all for the sake of her sister.
This is a story about a siscon girl who ignored her own destiny, to bring happiness to her sister.
nanomancer-Reborn-Ive-become-a-snow-girl:
I'm captured? Fine, I can't help it since I can't move. Experimented on? At least give me some anaesthetic.
I'm freed? Let me get some revenge. Want to plead for your life? Sorry, this miss here holds a grudge.
I destroyed the lab so now let me explore this world freely. I somehow joined Mr Hero's party. Fine, he seems fun.
“Aiya, how cruel. For the honour of being a hero you'd kill this missy huh?” She smiled whilst bleeding out.
“Che, you still have the mind to joke right now?” He said with a glare.
“What is life if not to enjoy every moment? Since I'm going to die and I can't avenge myself, I hope someone else does.”
“No one will. You were the only one who was more powerful than I with your Nanomancy. Now with you out of th-”
“Hush child. I'm trying to die in peace here.” “But I'm ol-!”
“Ap! Good children don't disturb their elders.” “But yo-!” “Bye~”
She grinned before losing strength. “F*CK!”…
Why am I sleeping in the snowfields? Mr Wolves are growling at me. Hungry huh?... Me too.
This is my second book please have mercy on this author. Enjoy.

out-of-control-into-your-everything:
Julian Ford is Scarlett Shaw's boyfriend's older brother. He is an unattainable presence.
Scarlett is interested in money and looks, not people, yet she gradually loses control.
Only he tramples on her, manipulating her at will.
Everyone mocks Scarlett, saying she's overestimating herself, shamelessly attempting to climb high.
Later—
Someone sees the man pressing Scarlett into a corner, his eyes bloodshot, kneeling on one knee, “Scarlett, marry me, I beg you.”
paragon-of-death:
Life from birth has been nothing but hell. I lost my parents to some stupid aristocrats whom they offended. Executed for no good reason.
My relatives abandoned me and pushed me aside. They feared for their lives and left me and my sister to starve and wander the streets alone!
No, this is worse than hell!
I watched my sister die of starvation. Her lips were dry and her feet bloody. Her nails were broken and her fingers riddled with cuts. She struggled in my hands and after a few seconds of struggle she passed away. She seemed joyful in death so I prayed mine will come just as swift and merciful as hers.
So I stayed in the alleyway, alone with her rotten corpse awaiting my fate for God knows how long. I could see it already. The darkness encroaching from all sides
Everyone said death is scary but I say it’s the end! Who needs life after death? What is the need for reincarnation?
Who would want to return to this crazy world?
“It’s not yet time for you to go… You have one more task to accomplish as my host” A voice called out to me.
I could barely see or speak but how can I miss such a beautiful face? It was an extremely handsome man who gazed at me with tender eyes.
